title: iPhone free for 17 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 17 min (since 18:47Z; released by user). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: menu-layers (owner fix-menu-layers; its wait names the phone).
What unblocks it: the next of fix-menu-layers takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).
